run_optimize_tsp: run the traveling salesman problem optimizer with a specified LLM model and starting algorithm
test_optimizer_server: test the optimizer LLM server by sending a simple yes/no question and verifying the response
evaluate_tsp_distance: evaluate the total distance of a TSP trace given x and y coordinate arrays
solve_tsp: solve the traveling salesman problem using nearest neighbor, farthest insertion, or dynamic programming algorithm
gen_meta_prompt: generate a meta-prompt for the LLM optimizer containing point coordinates and previous trace solutions
